system.description: A soft radiance around the user.
Warns of hostile alignment in objects or adjoining rooms; not on persons or creatures; does not say what the danger is. Detects hostile magic in a charged object.
Restores 1d6 lost hit points to any being. Not for radiation damage.
Detects the thoughts of living beings (not undead or automatons) in adjoining rooms. Nonhuman thought comes through only as garble.
Two-way silent speech with one character; useless without a shared language.
Undead cannot enter; +1 to all saving throws; attackers' damage -2.
Restores 2d6 lost hit points. Placed 9th following the spell descriptions; the skill table in Sec. 430 does not list it.
Controls 1-6 persons or intelligent nonhumans (not animals, Underworld creatures or automatons). No effect above 7th level.
Lifts curses, changes the alignment of magical weapons, restores magically changed beings and objects, cures magical madness. One person or object.
Restores a slain human or intelligent nonhuman within one week of death, by the subject's Constitution chance. No fighting for a week. Once a week at level VIII or below; once a day above VIII.
Total control of one's own body: hold breath, stop heartbeat, iron grip, trance, perfect recall. Broken only by very powerful magic or a being of 9+ hit dice.
Illusions about the user only. Believed 60% by nonintelligent creatures, 40% by intelligent ones, never by automatons. Damage from a believed illusion is real. Must be seen to work.
Hear what happens in an adjoining room.
See an adjoining room or space.
Moves solid objects through air or water: 1 ounce and 10 ft per level. Can stun an unarmoured man on a hit but not kill. Cannot move edged weapons or missiles.
Speak with the dead, spirits, and distant living beings (over five miles away).
Controls 1d12 animals or plants. Not nonhumans, Underworld creatures or undead.
As the priestly spell: 1-6 persons, no effect above 7th level.
Controls 1d12 undead, or makes a zombie from a dead being that obeys for six turns.
Controls 1-6 Underworld creatures; not humans, intelligent nonhumans or undead.
Instant death, no saving throw, on a hit by touch (risking a dying blow). Revival possible at -10% Constitution chance; no strenuous action for a week.
Calms walls of Wind or Water, storms, and rioting mobs of first-level beings.
Rations for 1d10 persons.
Creates 1-3 one-hit-die beasts, warriors, crawlers, flyers or undead that serve the caster, then vanish.
system.waitAfter: Levels I-V: one week before any other spell; VI-VIII: two days; IX+: none (once a day).

system.description: 1-6 beings get +1 morale and +1 to hit, or 1-6 enemies get -1 to hit.
Dispels an oncoming illusion if there is time before it arrives.
Dispels an opposing good or evil spell operating within range.
Opens or closes a normal-sized door and holds it; broken only by another Door Control.
One opponent panics and flees defenceless. Takes two rounds to arrive; a Dispel Evil can stop it. Write the casting down when cast.
Heals 1d6 lost hit points, never above the original total.
Rise up to 60 ft per turn to a maximum of 120 ft, vertical only, soft landing at the end.
Daylight. Negates the chance of surprise.
Feels gold and gems even if buried or invisible.
Homes in on a familiar object the user has handled. Not outdoors.
Victim goes permanently insane. Blocked by Control of Self; cured by Remove Curse.
Victim dies at the start of the next round or turn unless Cure Disease is cast. Revival costs 5 extra Constitution.
Protects the user and 1-6 companions from undead, apparitions and Control Person. Not from weapons or Eyes.
Opponents who fail are blind for one turn, unable to attack or defend. Dispelled by Light cast at the start of the next round.
See other planes, invisible things and dimensional doors. Cast within 10 ft the user may cast again next round; 11-20 ft, not.

Charms an animal, nonhuman or Underworld creature (not automatons). Equal or more HD than caster: normal save. 1-2 HD fewer: save only on a prior 60+ on d100; 3-4 fewer: 75+; 5-6 fewer: 85+; 7+ fewer: no save.
Hits 1-3 beings (d6: 1-2 one, 3-4 two, 5-6 three) for 5d6.
Creates 1-2 three-hit-dice beings that serve the caster.
system.waitAfter: Cannot be cast at levels I-III. IV-VI: one week before any other spell; VII-VIII: two days; IX: one day; above IX: none.

system.description: Cures any disease instantly in one person; 75% on a nonhuman or animal. Does not heal wounds.
Suspends many spells (e.g. Mind-Bar, Petrification), amulet powers and weapon or armour enchantments. No effect on Eyes or ancient devices.
See through solids.

name: The Hands of Krá the Mighty

system.description: Grapples and crushes: on a failed save, roll 1d6 for the number of d6 of damage.
Heals 2d6 lost hit points, never above the original total.
1-6 beings including the user become invisible: +3 to their saving throws, +2 to the score needed to hit them.
Counts as a successful save against poison, bites or stings; full health restored.
One enemy is paralysed. It saves again next turn or the paralysis becomes permanent (only the Eye of Healing removes it).
Turns the victim to stone; removed by Remove Curse or Dispel Magic. A failed save also costs one hit die permanently.
2d6 beings of levels I-III, or 1d6 of levels IV-V; none of VI+. Not automatons, androids, undead, animals or Ahoggyá.
1d12 beings move at half or double speed (two blows a round, or one every other round). Only once on the same beings.
Changes a 20 x 20 ft open, flat area of earth, stone, water or mud into another form of the same substance; mud costs 90% of movement.
Visible poison cloud 50 x 50 ft, moving 10 ft a turn with the wind. Failed save: dead unless Neutralise Poison is cast at once. Made save: 1d6.

Withers limbs (d6: 1 left arm, 2 right arm, 3 left leg, 4 right leg, 5 both arms or legs, 6 one arm and one leg). Only the Eye of Regeneration restores. Even on a save, Cure Disease, Neutralise Poison or Remove Curse is needed at once or 2d6 damage.
Magic Users only. 1-6 opponents behave as an animal the caster knows (without its form or hit dice), until an Eye of Transformation.
1-3 illusions. Opponents roll d100: 1-30 believe (damage real), 31-60 dubious (40% chance damage is real), 61-100 disbelieve.
User and 1-6 others take any animal, insect, nonhuman or human form (not a specific person). Undone by Remove Curse. Changed casters cannot cast. Blocked by Control of Self.
Makes a 10-ft tunnel, wall or boulder in natural earth or stone only.
One very powerful 5-hit-dice being serves the caster.
system.waitAfter: Cannot be cast at levels I-VI. VII-VIII: one week before any other spell; IX: two days; above IX: one day; XII+: once a day freely.

system.description: A large demon with 7 hit dice and flying speed serves the caster.
system.waitAfter: Cannot be cast at levels I-VIII. IX-X: one week before any other spell; XI-XIII: two days; above XIII: one day.

system.description: Roll 2d6 for aim: 7-9 on target, under 7 short, over 9 long; a 2 catches the caster. Blast radius 30 ft. Save 17+ (levels I-IV), 15+ (V-VII), 13+ (higher) or die; a save still takes 2d6.
Enchants an unenchanted steel weapon, helmet, shield or armour: d6 1-3 +1, 4-5 +2, 6 +3. Affects hit or defence only, not damage.
Lightning hits 1d12 beings. Even a successful save takes 1d6. The 1975 text does not state the effect of a failed save: referee's ruling.
Fly at 120 ft a turn with up to 250 lb extra, rising to 180 ft.
A glittering wall before the user: enemies pass only on 18+ on d20; +2 to the score needed to hit the user; 75% to stop Cold or the Eye of Frigid Breath; stops walls of water and ice.
Immune to Chlén-hide and ordinary steel weapons and non-magical missiles. If already active, also proof against Doomkill, the Silver Halo and Telekinesis.
Makes one being do or refrain from an action. No effect on level VI+.
Sends 1d12 beings on a quest; released by Dispel Magic or Remove Curse.
Animates 2d6 dead beings as obedient zombies with their old hit dice; they hit at -2 and deal -3 damage.
Reincarnates one dead being in another form, keeping its hit dice. Undone by Dispel Magic (still dead).
Allows the character to research a new spell under terms the referee sets. Only possible if this spell is taken.
Disease and plague on 2d6 beings; they die within two turns unless Cure Disease is cast.
User and 1-6 companions are protected from missiles, the Energy Bolt, the Hands of Krá and Telekinesis, and from creatures and soldiers of levels I-III.

name: The Silver Halo of Soul Stealing

system.description: Takes one being's soul. Only Dispel Magic restores it (60%). Deflected by Invulnerability or Dispel Evil/Good, with 25% to strike someone nearby.
User and 1d12 beings go to a place the user knows. Beyond range: 25% safe; otherwise 50% lost forever, 30% elsewhere on Tékumel, 20% on another planet.
Send one wall a day: Fire, Ice, Stone, Swords, Tanglevines, Water or Wind. Each has its own speed, range, and interactions (Sec. 510 no. 21). Walls have 2d6 hit points and fight other walls on 15+.
Rain, storm, snow or sun, outdoors only. Ended by Dispel Magic; damage at the referee's option.
A limited wish granted within the referee's bounds. Once per week.
